label: Vim
headline: Vim Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for Vim commands — from basic motions and insert mode to search, replace, macros, and managing multiple files.

items.name: h j k l
items.definition: Move left, down, up, right — the arrow key equivalents.

items.name: Start of line
items.definition: Jump to the very start of the current line.

items.name: First non-blank
items.definition: Jump to the first non-blank character of the current line.

items.name: End of line
items.definition: Jump to the end of the current line.

items.name: Previous word
items.definition: Move backward to the start of the previous word.

items.name: Next word
items.definition: Move forward to the start of the next word.

items.name: End of word
items.definition: Move forward to the end of the current or next word.

items.name: Find character
items.definition: Jump forward to the next occurrence of a character on the line.

items.name: Find back
items.definition: Jump backward to the previous occurrence of a character on the line.

items.name: Half page up/down
items.definition: Scroll half a page up or down.

items.name: Full page up/down
items.definition: Scroll a full page up or down.

items.name: First line
items.definition: Jump to the first line of the file.

items.name: Last line
items.definition: Jump to the last line of the file.

items.name: Go to line n
items.definition: Jump to line number n.

items.name: Next empty line
items.definition: Jump to the next blank line (paragraph forward).

items.name: Previous empty line
items.definition: Jump to the previous blank line (paragraph backward).

items.name: Screen top/mid/bot
items.definition: Jump to the top, middle, or bottom line visible on screen.

items.name: Center current line
items.definition: Scroll the screen so the current line is centered.

items.name: Insert before cursor
items.definition: Enter insert mode before the cursor.

items.name: Insert after cursor
items.definition: Enter insert mode after the cursor.

items.name: Insert start of line
items.definition: Enter insert mode at the first non-blank character of the line.

items.name: Insert end of line
items.definition: Enter insert mode at the end of the current line.

items.name: New line below
items.definition: Open a new line below the current line and enter insert mode.

items.name: New line above
items.definition: Open a new line above the current line and enter insert mode.

items.name: Delete char & insert
items.definition: Delete the character under the cursor and enter insert mode.

items.name: Delete line & insert
items.definition: Delete the current line and enter insert mode.

items.name: Change to end of line
items.definition: Delete from cursor to end of line and enter insert mode.

items.name: Last insert point
items.definition: Enter insert mode at the position of the last insert.

items.name: Exit insert mode
items.definition: Return to normal mode from insert mode.

items.name: Save
items.definition: Write (save) the current file.

items.name: Quit
items.definition: Close the current file (fails if unsaved changes exist).

items.name: Save and quit
items.definition: Save the file and quit Vim.

items.name: Force quit
items.definition: Quit without saving, discarding all changes.

items.name: Save and quit all
items.definition: Save all open files and quit Vim.

items.name: Close all
items.definition: Close all open files (fails if any have unsaved changes).

items.name: Force quit all
items.definition: Force quit all files, discarding all changes.

items.name: Save to file
items.definition: Write the current buffer to a specific file name.

items.name: Save as
items.definition: Save the file under a new name and start editing it.

items.name: Write readonly file
items.definition: Save a file that requires sudo permissions.

items.name: Replace character
items.definition: Replace the character under the cursor with another character.

items.name: Replace mode
items.definition: Enter replace mode — typed characters overwrite existing ones.

items.name: Undo
items.definition: Undo the last change. Prefix with a number to undo multiple times.

items.name: Undo line
items.definition: Undo all changes made to the current line.

items.name: Redo
items.definition: Redo the last undone change.

items.name: Join lines
items.definition: Join the current line with the next line.

items.name: Repeat last command
items.definition: Repeat the last normal-mode change command.

items.name: Delete character
items.definition: Delete the character under the cursor (cuts to register).

items.name: Delete word
items.definition: Delete from cursor to the start of the next word.

items.name: Delete line
items.definition: Delete the entire current line.

items.name: Delete to end
items.definition: Delete from cursor to the end of the line.

items.name: Yank (copy) line
items.definition: Copy the current line into the register.

items.name: Paste after
items.definition: Paste the register contents after the cursor.

items.name: Paste before
items.definition: Paste the register contents before the cursor.

items.name: Swap characters
items.definition: Transpose (swap) two characters.

items.name: Swap lines
items.definition: Swap the current line with the line below.

items.name: Yank to clipboard
items.definition: Yank (copy) selected text to the system clipboard.

items.name: Paste from clipboard
items.definition: Paste from the system clipboard.

items.name: Visual mode
items.definition: Enter character-wise visual mode to select text.

items.name: Visual line mode
items.definition: Enter line-wise visual mode to select whole lines.

items.name: Visual block mode
items.definition: Enter block (column) visual mode to select a rectangle of text.

items.name: Select all
items.definition: Select the entire file.

items.name: Indent selection
items.definition: Shift the selected text one indent level to the right.

items.name: Outdent selection
items.definition: Shift the selected text one indent level to the left.

items.name: Delete selection
items.definition: Cut the current visual selection.

items.name: Yank selection
items.definition: Copy the current visual selection.

items.name: d — delete
items.definition: Delete text covered by the motion (e.g. dw, dd, d$).

items.name: y — yank
items.definition: Copy text covered by the motion (e.g. yy, yw, y$).

items.name: c — change
items.definition: Delete text and enter insert mode (e.g. cw, cc, c$).

items.name: = — format
items.definition: Auto-indent code covered by the motion (e.g. gg=G for whole file).

items.name: gU — uppercase
items.definition: Convert text to uppercase (e.g. gUU for current line).

items.name: gu — lowercase
items.definition: Convert text to lowercase (e.g. guu for current line).

items.name: Count prefix
items.definition: Repeat an operator n times (e.g. 3dd deletes 3 lines, 6yy copies 6).

items.name: Inner word
items.definition: Select the word under the cursor, without surrounding spaces.

items.name: Around word
items.definition: Select the word under the cursor, including surrounding spaces.

items.name: Inner quotes
items.definition: Select text inside the nearest quote pair.

items.name: Around quotes
items.definition: Select text including the surrounding quotes.

items.name: Inner brackets
items.definition: Select text inside the nearest bracket pair.

items.name: Around brackets
items.definition: Select text including the surrounding bracket pair.

items.name: Inner paragraph
items.definition: Select the current paragraph (text block between blank lines).

items.name: Inner tag
items.definition: Select the content inside an HTML/XML tag.

items.name: Change inner word
items.definition: Delete the word under the cursor and enter insert mode.

items.name: Change inner quotes
items.definition: Delete the content inside quotes and enter insert mode.

items.name: Delete inner word
items.definition: Delete the word under the cursor.

items.name: Delete in quotes
items.definition: Delete everything inside the nearest quotes.

items.name: Search forward
items.definition: Search forward for a pattern. Press Enter to jump to the first match.

items.name: Search backward
items.definition: Search backward for a pattern.

items.name: Next match
items.definition: Jump to the next match in the search direction.

items.name: Previous match
items.definition: Jump to the previous match.

items.name: Search current word
items.definition: Search forward for the word under the cursor.

items.name: Search word back
items.definition: Search backward for the word under the cursor.

items.name: Case insensitive
items.definition: Search with case-insensitive matching.

items.name: Regex search
items.definition: Search using a regular expression (\v enables 'very magic' mode).

items.name: Clear highlights
items.definition: Clear search highlighting without cancelling the search pattern.

items.name: Replace first (line)
items.definition: Replace the first occurrence of 'old' with 'new' on the current line.

items.name: Replace all (line)
items.definition: Replace all occurrences of 'old' on the current line.

items.name: Replace with confirm
items.definition: Replace all on the current line, asking for confirmation each time.

items.name: Replace first (file)
items.definition: Replace the first occurrence on every line in the file.

items.name: Replace all (file)
items.definition: Replace every occurrence of 'old' with 'new' throughout the file.

items.name: Replace (confirm)
items.definition: Replace all in file, asking for confirmation at each match.

items.name: Replace (ignore case)
items.definition: Replace all in file, ignoring case.

items.name: Replace in range
items.definition: Replace all occurrences between lines 2 and 6.

items.name: Record macro
items.definition: Start recording a macro into register {letter} (e.g. qa records into 'a').

items.name: Stop recording
items.definition: Stop recording the current macro.

items.name: Run macro
items.definition: Execute the macro stored in register {letter}.

items.name: Run macro n times
items.definition: Execute a macro n times (e.g. 7@a runs macro 'a' seven times).

items.name: Repeat last macro
items.definition: Re-run the most recently executed macro.

items.name: Edit file
items.definition: Open a file in a new buffer.

items.name: Next buffer
items.definition: Switch to the next buffer.

items.name: Previous buffer
items.definition: Switch to the previous buffer.

items.name: Delete buffer
items.definition: Remove the current file from the buffer list.

items.name: List buffers
items.definition: List all currently open buffers.

items.name: Go to buffer
items.definition: Switch to a buffer by file name.

items.name: Split open
items.definition: Open a file in a horizontal split.

items.name: Vertical split open
items.definition: Open a file in a vertical split.

items.name: Split horizontal
items.definition: Split the current window horizontally.

items.name: Split vertical
items.definition: Split the current window vertically.

items.name: Switch window
items.definition: Cycle focus to the next window.

items.name: Close window
items.definition: Close the focused window.

items.name: Move left/right
items.definition: Move focus to the window on the left or right.

items.name: Move up/down
items.definition: Move focus to the window above or below.

items.name: Equal size
items.definition: Make all windows equally sized.

items.name: Swap windows
items.definition: Swap the current window with the next one.

items.name: New tab
items.definition: Open a file in a new tab.

items.name: Close tab
items.definition: Close the current tab.

items.name: Close other tabs
items.definition: Close all tabs except the current one.

items.name: List tabs
items.definition: List all open tabs and their windows.

items.name: Next tab
items.definition: Move to the next tab.

items.name: Previous tab
items.definition: Move to the previous tab.

items.name: Go to tab n
items.definition: Jump directly to tab number n.

items.name: Set mark
items.definition: Mark the current cursor position with a letter (e.g. ma).

items.name: Jump to mark
items.definition: Jump to the exact position of mark {letter}.

items.name: Jump to mark line
items.definition: Jump to the beginning of the line containing mark {letter}.

items.name: Last insert position
items.definition: Jump to where the cursor was when insert mode was last exited.

items.name: Last change
items.definition: Jump to the position of the last change in the current buffer.

items.name: List marks
items.definition: Show all current marks and their positions.

items.name: Delete mark
items.definition: Delete a specific mark.

items.name: Open fold
items.definition: Open (expand) the fold under the cursor.

items.name: Close fold
items.definition: Close (collapse) the fold under the cursor.

items.name: Toggle fold
items.definition: Toggle the fold under the cursor open or closed.

items.name: Open all folds
items.definition: Open every fold in the file.

items.name: Close all folds
items.definition: Close every fold in the file.

items.name: Toggle case
items.definition: Toggle the case of the character under the cursor.

items.name: Uppercase word
items.definition: Select the current word and convert it to uppercase.

items.name: Lowercase word
items.definition: Select the current word and convert it to lowercase.

items.name: Increase number
items.definition: Increment the number under the cursor.

items.name: Decrease number
items.definition: Decrement the number under the cursor.

items.name: Go back (jump)
items.definition: Jump back to the previous cursor location in the jump list.

items.name: Go forward (jump)
items.definition: Jump forward in the jump list.

items.name: Go to file
items.definition: Open the file whose name is under the cursor.

items.name: Help
items.definition: Open Vim's built-in help for a topic.

items.name: Reload file
items.definition: Discard changes and reload the current file from disk.

items.name: Open terminal
items.definition: Open a terminal window inside Vim.

items.name: Sort lines
items.definition: Sort all lines in the file (or a selected range) alphabetically.

items.name: Shell command
items.definition: Execute a shell command without leaving Vim.

items.name: Insert command output
items.definition: Insert the output of a shell command into the buffer.

items.name: Delete lines matching
items.definition: Delete every line in the file that contains the pattern 'foo'.

items.name: Delete blank lines
items.definition: Remove all blank/whitespace-only lines from the file.
